pathParams.name: InspectionId
pathParams.description: Unique identifier of the inspection to update

requestBody.description: Attributes to update for the inspection

attributes.name: Name
attributes.description: The user-provided name of the inspection.

attributes.name: URL
attributes.description: The URL link to an external page hosted by the partner with additional details about the inspection.

attributes.name: InspectionDate
attributes.description: The date the inspection was or is scheduled to be conducted. Valid format is "YYYY-MM-DD" e.g. "2025-03-25".

attributes.name: Status
attributes.description: Indicates the current status of the inspection. Valid values for update include "NEW", "IN PROGRESS", "DONE", "OUT FOR SIGNING", or "SIGNED".

attributes.name: OccupancyId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the occupancy to associate with the inspection. Only one of OccupancyId, PropertyId, or UnitId may be specified.

attributes.name: PropertyId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the property to associate with the inspection. Only one of OccupancyId, PropertyId, or UnitId may be specified.

attributes.name: UnitId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the unit to associate with the inspection. Only one of OccupancyId, PropertyId, or UnitId may be specified.

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the updated inspection
